definition.title: Catch the users of a tool that is shutting down
definition.description: Weekly or on demand: find nearby tools that are shutting down, dropping a free tier, repricing or relicensing, pick the one whose users you can honestly serve, and get a dated rescue kit built around their export file and deadline.

product_url.title: Your product's website
product_url.description: Leave empty to use the project context.

neighbor_tools.title: Tools your users also use or could replace with you
neighbor_tools.description: Optional. Competitors, tools upstream or downstream of you, and platforms your users build on. Tin adds its own if you leave this short.

known_event.title: A shutdown or price change you already know about
known_event.description: Optional. Paste the announcement link or describe it. It is checked like any other event, not taken on trust.

lookback_days.title: How far back to look for announcements (days)
